extracted.name: Yummy Pomegranate Vinaigrette Dressing
extracted.description: This tangy and refreshing pomegranate dressing is ready in minutes and goes great on any green or grain salad.
instruction_lines: Place olive oil, pomegranate juice, rice vinegar, white sugar, shallots, garlic, white pepper, and salt in a blender. Blend until smooth, about 2 minutes.
